terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.sec1Text: Welcome to FeastIQ. By accessing or using our intelligent AI-powered food ordering platform (the "Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.
terms.sec2Text: FeastIQ is a technology platform connecting hungry customers with local partner restaurants. Our application integrates computer vision food classification models, personalized recommendation engines, and a conversational assistant powered by the Groq API to help you discover dishes, browse menus, and place orders.
terms.sec3Text: You must register with accurate information and maintain the security of your password. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account. FeastIQ is not liable for any losses arising from unauthorized use of your account.
terms.sec4Text: All orders placed on FeastIQ are subject to the availability of partner restaurants. Currently, our service supports Cash on Delivery. Menu prices and delivery fees are set by restaurants and are subject to change at any time.
terms.sec5Text: Our artificial intelligence features (including Groq API suggestions and food image classifiers) are provided for guidance to enhance your discovery experience. While we strive for accuracy, AI-generated dish descriptions, allergen alerts, and nutritional estimates may occasionally vary.
terms.sec6Text: FeastIQ acts as a technology intermediary facilitating connections. We do not prepare food or directly control the kitchens of partner restaurants. Restaurants are solely responsible for the quality, food safety, and compliance of delivered dishes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Text: At FeastIQ, we take the protection of your privacy very seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share your personal information when you use our intelligent ordering platform.
privacy.accInfoText: Your name, email address, and encrypted password during registration.
privacy.orderInfoText: Your order history, favorites, and interactions with our AI assistant and recommendation engine.
privacy.mediaInfoText: Food photos submitted through our visual classifier to search for similar items.
privacy.sec3Text: Your data is processed to operate the FeastIQ platform, personalize your food recommendations via our AI engine, process your queries sent through the Groq API, route your orders to partner restaurants, and send you real-time tracking updates.
privacy.sec4Text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share necessary information (such as your order details and delivery instructions) with the relevant partner restaurant to fulfill and deliver your meal.
privacy.sec5Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.sec6Text: You have the right to access your personal information, request correction of inaccurate data, or delete your account directly from your profile settings or by contacting our support team.
